result.brief: 提出 MemComposer 三阶段系统，从用户视频集合构建实体记忆，规划、检索条件帧并迭代生成与批判，实现多镜头 B-roll 序列生成，保证身份、场景与序列级一致性。
result.reason: Collection-grounded multi-shot video generation with memory-based planning, retrieval of conditioning frames, and iterative consistency critique directly advances controllable long-form video generation.
